subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch to a fixed YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm absolute timestamp, a locale-aware full timestamp, or keep the current relative-first display?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent display contract affects Control UI ergonomics, localization, and the currently open implementation PR direction.

options.title: Adopt a narrow absolute-time UI change
options.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR with a small formatter/rendering change that preserves localized fallback and adds browser proof.

options.title: Keep relative-first display
options.body: Close this feature as not planned and leave the current relative Updated value as the intended Control UI behavior.

options.title: Use locale-aware full timestamp
options.body: Implement the change through the existing Control UI date/time preference helpers instead of hard-coding YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow absolute-time UI change
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR with a small formatter/rendering change that preserves localized fallback and adds browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current-file move and has the strongest recent history on the Control UI Sessions surface.
